(* ---- состав маршрутов: обход связей от головных механизмов при положениях клапанов маршрута ---- *) IF NOT xInit THEN FOR r := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_ROUTE DO FOR v := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_VALVE DO aPosT[v] := GVL_Const.ROUTE_VALVE[r, v]; END_FOR nL := F_BuildLinks(aPos := aPosT, aLinks := aL); FOR i := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_MECH DO GVL.aMember[r, i] := FALSE; END_FOR FOR b := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_BUNKER DO GVL.aMemberB[r, b] := FALSE; END_FOR GVL.aRouteCfgErr[r] := FALSE; FOR h := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_HEAD DO IF GVL_Const.ROUTE_HEAD[r, h] > 0 THEN GVL.aMember[r, GVL_Const.ROUTE_HEAD[r, h]] := TRUE; END_IF END_FOR FOR p := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_MECH DO FOR k := 1 TO nL DO IF GVL.aMember[r, aL[k].iFrom] THEN CASE aL[k].eTo OF GVL_Const.LT_MECH: GVL.aMember[r, aL[k].iTo] := TRUE; GVL_Const.LT_BUNKER: GVL.aMemberB[r, aL[k].iTo] := TRUE; ELSE GVL.aRouteCfgErr[r] := TRUE; END_CASE END_IF END_FOR END_FOR END_FOR xInit := TRUE; END_IF
FOR r := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_ROUTE DO xToggle := (GVL_HMI.aHmiRoute[r].wCmd AND GVL_Const.RC_TOGGLE) <> 0; xStop := (GVL_HMI.aHmiRoute[r].wCmd AND GVL_Const.RC_STOP) <> 0 OR GVL.xStopAll; GVL_HMI.aHmiRoute[r].wCmd := 0;
xConflict := FALSE; FOR p := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_ROUTE DO IF p <> r AND GVL_Const.ROUTE_CONFLICT[r, p] AND GVL.aRouteState[p] <> GVL_Const.RST_IDLE THEN xConflict := TRUE; END_IF END_FOR
xValvesOk := TRUE; FOR v := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_VALVE DO IF GVL_Const.ROUTE_VALVE[r, v] <> 0 AND GVL.aValvePos[v] <> GVL_Const.ROUTE_VALVE[r, v] THEN xValvesOk := FALSE; END_IF END_FOR
(* ---- контроль аварий активного маршрута ---- *) IF GVL.aRouteState[r] <> GVL_Const.RST_IDLE AND GVL.aRouteState[r] <> GVL_Const.RST_STOPPING THEN xFault := NOT GVL.xGlobalOk; FOR i := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_MECH DO IF GVL.aMember[r, i] AND (GVL.aAlarm[i] OR NOT GVL.aAuto[i]) THEN xFault := TRUE; END_IF END_FOR FOR v := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_VALVE DO IF GVL_Const.ROUTE_VALVE[r, v] <> 0 AND GVL.aValveAlarm[v] THEN xFault := TRUE; END_IF END_FOR FOR b := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_BUNKER DO IF GVL.aMemberB[r, b] AND GVL.aBunkerAlarm[b] THEN xFault := TRUE; END_IF END_FOR IF GVL.aRouteState[r] = GVL_Const.RST_RUN AND NOT xValvesOk THEN xFault := TRUE; END_IF IF xFault THEN GVL.aRouteFault[r] := TRUE; GVL.aRouteState[r] := GVL_Const.RST_STOPPING; END_IF END_IF
CASE GVL.aRouteState[r] OF GVL_Const.RST_IDLE: IF GVL.xReset THEN GVL.aRouteFault[r] := FALSE; aNotReady[r] := FALSE; END_IF IF xToggle THEN iBad := 0; IF NOT GVL.xGlobalOk THEN iBad := -1; ELSIF xConflict THEN iBad := -2; ELSIF GVL.aRouteCfgErr[r] THEN iBad := -3; ELSE FOR i := GVL_Const.N_MECH TO 1 BY -1 DO IF GVL.aMember[r, i] AND NOT GVL.aReady[i] THEN iBad := i; END_IF END_FOR IF iBad = 0 THEN FOR v := GVL_Const.N_VALVE TO 1 BY -1 DO IF GVL_Const.ROUTE_VALVE[r, v] <> 0 AND NOT GVL.aValveReady[v] THEN iBad := 100 + v; END_IF END_FOR END_IF IF iBad = 0 THEN FOR b := GVL_Const.N_BUNKER TO 1 BY -1 DO IF GVL.aMemberB[r, b] AND GVL.aBunkerAlarm[b] THEN iBad := 200 + b; END_IF END_FOR END_IF END_IF GVL_HMI.aHmiRoute[r].iNotReady := iBad; aNotReady[r] := iBad <> 0; IF iBad = 0 THEN GVL.aRouteFault[r] := FALSE; GVL.aRouteState[r] := GVL_Const.RST_PRESTART; END_IF END_IF
GVL_Const.RST_PRESTART: IF xStop OR xToggle THEN GVL.aRouteState[r] := GVL_Const.RST_IDLE; ELSIF aTonPre[r].Q THEN GVL.aRouteState[r] := GVL_Const.RST_VALVES; END_IF
GVL_Const.RST_VALVES: IF xStop OR xToggle THEN GVL.aRouteState[r] := GVL_Const.RST_STOPPING; ELSIF xValvesOk THEN GVL.aRouteState[r] := GVL_Const.RST_RUN; END_IF
GVL_Const.RST_RUN: IF xStop OR xToggle THEN GVL.aRouteState[r] := GVL_Const.RST_STOPPING; END_IF
GVL_Const.RST_STOPPING: (* ждать останова всех механизмов маршрута, кроме занятых другим работающим маршрутом *) xBusy := FALSE; FOR i := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_MECH DO IF GVL.aMember[r, i] AND GVL.aRun[i] THEN xShared := FALSE; FOR p := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_ROUTE DO IF p <> r AND GVL.aRouteState[p] = GVL_Const.RST_RUN AND GVL.aMember[p, i] THEN xShared := TRUE; END_IF END_FOR IF NOT xShared THEN xBusy := TRUE; END_IF END_IF END_FOR IF NOT xBusy THEN GVL.aRouteState[r] := GVL_Const.RST_IDLE; END_IF END_CASE
aTonPre[r](IN := GVL.aRouteState[r] = GVL_Const.RST_PRESTART, PT := F_Sec(GVL_Retain.stGlobPar.uTPreStart)); END_FOR
(* ---- требования к механизмам и клапанам ---- *) FOR i := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_MECH DO GVL.aDemand[i] := FALSE; FOR r := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_ROUTE DO IF GVL.aRouteState[r] = GVL_Const.RST_RUN AND GVL.aMember[r, i] THEN GVL.aDemand[i] := TRUE; END_IF END_FOR GVL.aDemand[i] := GVL.aDemand[i] AND NOT GVL.aBlocked[i]; END_FOR
GVL.xPreStart := FALSE; FOR v := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_VALVE DO GVL.aValveTarget[v] := 0; END_FOR FOR r := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_ROUTE DO IF GVL.aRouteState[r] = GVL_Const.RST_PRESTART THEN GVL.xPreStart := TRUE; END_IF IF GVL.aRouteState[r] <> GVL_Const.RST_IDLE THEN FOR v := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_VALVE DO IF GVL_Const.ROUTE_VALVE[r, v] <> 0 THEN GVL.aValveTarget[v] := GVL_Const.ROUTE_VALVE[r, v]; END_IF END_FOR END_IF END_FOR
(* ---- состояние для панели ---- *) FOR r := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_ROUTE DO xConflict := FALSE; FOR p := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_ROUTE DO IF p <> r AND GVL_Const.ROUTE_CONFLICT[r, p] AND GVL.aRouteState[p] <> GVL_Const.RST_IDLE THEN xConflict := TRUE; END_IF END_FOR xPaused := FALSE; xAllRun := GVL.aRouteState[r] = GVL_Const.RST_RUN; FOR i := 1 TO GVL_Const.N_MECH DO IF GVL.aMember[r, i] THEN IF GVL.aBlocked[i] THEN xPaused := TRUE; ELSIF NOT GVL.aRun[i] THEN xAllRun := FALSE; END_IF END_IF END_FOR wSts := 0; IF GVL.aRouteState[r] <> GVL_Const.RST_IDLE THEN wSts := wSts OR GVL_Const.RS_ACTIVE; END_IF IF GVL.aRouteState[r] = GVL_Const.RST_PRESTART THEN wSts := wSts OR GVL_Const.RS_PRESTART; END_IF IF GVL.aRouteState[r] = GVL_Const.RST_VALVES THEN wSts := wSts OR GVL_Const.RS_VALVES; END_IF IF GVL.aRouteState[r] = GVL_Const.RST_RUN THEN wSts := wSts OR GVL_Const.RS_RUN; END_IF IF GVL.aRouteState[r] = GVL_Const.RST_STOPPING THEN wSts := wSts OR GVL_Const.RS_STOPPING; END_IF IF xPaused AND GVL.aRouteState[r] = GVL_Const.RST_RUN THEN wSts := wSts OR GVL_Const.RS_PAUSED; END_IF IF GVL.aRouteFault[r] THEN wSts := wSts OR GVL_Const.RS_FAULT; END_IF IF aNotReady[r] THEN wSts := wSts OR GVL_Const.RS_NOTREADY; END_IF IF xConflict THEN wSts := wSts OR GVL_Const.RS_CONFLICT; END_IF IF xAllRun THEN wSts := wSts OR GVL_Const.RS_ALLRUN; END_IF GVL_HMI.aHmiRoute[r].wSts := wSts; GVL_HMI.aHmiRoute[r].iState := GVL.aRouteState[r]; END_FOR
